proxy_conventions.primary: Each expert/day starts from10k flat, trades exact unramped causal target and pays terminal exit; standalone one-day reference, not executable switches
proxy_conventions.secondary: Each of five original training episodes is a separate continuous single-expert quantity reference; fresh cash at episode start, paid exit at episode end, no gap stitching
proxy_conventions.utility: log1p(net_return)-0.5*daily_endpoint_MDD; daily endpoint_MDD=max(0,-net_return), no intraday drawdown certification
proxy_conventions.budget_ramp: Not applied to independent expert reference proxies; unchanged nativeL1<=.1 budget contract remains required for any future shared-wallet experiment
proxy_conventions.eligibility: Exact source masks; ineligible assets have original zero targets with retained exclusion reason; no invented economic input
proxy_conventions.risk_order: Uses frozen individual expert covariance-scaled targets; no new blend/budget/risk-order mapping; separate model-worker correction remains required

recommendation_criterion: Training-only mean positive utility excess over best of CASH/VOL/CS on ex-post BOTH_VOL_CS_NET_NEGATIVE days, primary fresh paid one-day reference; corroborate coverage, loss overlap and episode/continuous-reference evidence; no development fitting
stop: Stop on source, clock, state, target, covariance, mask or proxy-bridge mismatch;120CPU seconds and6GB per preparation task
